clause.quote: The size component MUST count the Quadlets/triplets in its following group.

description: A -J group of size 22 holding one D key of 11 quadlets, at the end of the stream: the count claims 11 quadlets that are not there. The specification has no sentence saying such a stream must be rejected; the assertion rests on the cited MUST, which this stream violates, so it cannot be decoded as a conforming stream. Any rejection satisfies the assertion; the class in the note is informative.
title: Reject a count that runs past the end of the stream
